posts.title: The TF2 SDK is OPEN SOURCE
posts.description: The Team Fortress 2 SDK has been released as open source software. This is a huge step for the modding community and the game itself, and we're going to take a look at what this means for the future of TF2.

posts.title: Linux, Tech Giants, and the Death of Consumer Freedom
posts.description: Microsoft finally broke me, so I decided to make the switch to Linux. In this post, I'll share my personal experience, my honest opinions, and a few words of caution for the Linux community.
